hosting.decision: The library ships as assets inside the app itself (versioned with the code that serves the pages) - no separate manual upload step, no extra account. Page creation references covers by key from this manifest. Citizen uploads live in user storage as today.

smart_covers.name: Smart Covers
smart_covers.what: The categorized cover library as a product: browsable in Smart Factory AND offered at page-creation time. Shawn 2026-10-25: people love done-for-you parts they get to pick - 'I picked it' is the feeling that attracts builders.
flow: 1. DEFAULT FIRST: every page is born with a cover already chosen by the system (area cover by page type) - nobody ever faces a blank page or a forced decision.
2. OPTIONAL CHOOSER: during page creation (and anytime after, via Change cover) the citizen may open Smart Covers: categories and search, FEATURED covers first, never the whole shelf dumped at once.
3. SMART SUGGESTION: using what the citizen told us (Welcome answers, page type, stated purpose), the system suggests the best-matching covers first - the auto-match idea applied to covers.
4. SKIP IS FREE: 'pick for me' is always one tap; the default is already beautiful.
5. CUSTOM PATH: any cover can be used as-is, or as the reference for a Naya-made custom version.
smart_covers.organization: three brand tiers (signature / jewel / open) x categories (abstract colorways, the-dimension, prosperity, sanctuary, celebration, craft, cosmos) - the manifest is the shelf data; featured = a rotating curated subset, seeded by Shawn's verdicts.

featured.rule: the chooser opens with these 12 only; the full library is one tap deeper (theme shelves + search). Curated by Shawn's favorites picks - chosen for broad appeal, not one taste. Proposed by Resolve from his verdicts so far; finalized by his picks.

library_organization.discovery: browse by theme shelf; search by name AND by mood - every cover carries mood tags (calm, bold, warm, radiant, cosmic, serene...) because people search feelings, not categories. The jewel/signature tiers act as a filter inside every shelf.
